description: Utility functions for converting table options and filters into user report options, handling sorting, filtering, pagination, and default selections in the Mattermost admin console's system users component.

methods.name: convertTableOptionsToUserReportOptions
methods.description: Converts table UI options into API-compatible user report options, including pagination, sorting, filtering, and date range.

methods.name: getSortColumnForOptions
methods.description: Maps a UI sort column ID to an API sort column name, defaulting to username.

methods.name: getSortDirectionForOptions
methods.description: Converts a UI sort direction to API sort direction, defaulting to ascending.

methods.name: getSortableColumnValueBySortColumn
methods.description: Retrieves the value from a user report row based on the specified sort column.

methods.name: getTeamFilterOption
methods.description: Generates team filter options based on team ID, including 'all teams' and 'no team' filters.

methods.name: getStatusFilterOption
methods.description: Creates filter options for active or deactivated user statuses.

methods.name: getPaginationInfo
methods.description: Returns a formatted pagination message based on current page and total users.

methods.name: getDefaultSelectedValueFromList
methods.description: Selects the default option from a list based on a value.

methods.name: getDefaultSelectedTeam
methods.description: Returns default team filter option based on team ID, with labels for 'all teams' and 'no teams'.

methods.name: getRoleFilterOption
methods.description: Creates role filter options, including guest filters.
